scenarios.name: Empty Lattice
scenarios.description: Empty lattice with no initial conditions.

comment.physical_purpose: Serves as the baseline state of the lattice with no initial particles or fields.
comment.expected_behavior: The lattice remains completely quiet and empty.

scenarios.name: Flux Pulse
scenarios.description: Single flux pulse propagating through the lattice.

comment.physical_purpose: Demonstrates single wave/flux pulse propagation through the discrete lattice.
comment.parameters: Gaussian envelope of flux in the center, with scale sigma = N / 10.0 and amplitude amp = K_B * 2.0.
comment.expected_behavior: Spherical expansion of flux pulse outward from center.

scenarios.description: Positive/negative flux dipole pair.

comment.physical_purpose: Simulates a positive and negative flux dipole pair.
comment.parameters: Two Gaussian flux centers located at N/4 and 3N/4, with positive and negative amplitudes respectively.
comment.expected_behavior: Dipole field configuration that propagates and interacts.

scenarios.description: Standing wave pattern in the lattice.

comment.physical_purpose: Establishes a standing wave pattern in the lattice.
comment.parameters: Two in-phase Gaussian flux sources spaced apart at N/3 and 2N/3.
comment.expected_behavior: Constructive and destructive interference forming stable standing wave peaks and troughs.

scenarios.name: Nested Standing
scenarios.description: Nested standing wave pattern.

comment.physical_purpose: Establishes a nested standing wave pattern across orthogonal dimensions.
comment.parameters: In-phase Gaussian flux sources along both x-axis (at N/3 and 2N/3) and z-axis (at N/4 and 3N/4).
comment.expected_behavior: Orthogonally overlapping standing waves creating a grid-like interference pattern.
